take_homes: Licence activated and people using it are different numbers. Ask for the second one.
Pick a tool against the outcome the person needs, not because it fits the platform we already have.
A plan needs named owners and a test with one real person before anything more is built.

monday.move: Ask my controller how she does the month-end variance commentary today, and what would make her drop her current way.
monday.stop_condition: If she says her current way works and nothing would change that, I build nothing.
monday.blocker: IT has not approved any tool for finance data, and I still have no cost per month for 40 people.

misconception.why: I came in thinking AI is a licence you buy. The point that access takes a minute and absorption takes other people's weeks made me see it is something the organisation has to build. I'm not fully changed: nobody gave me a price or a payback, so I still think of it as a spend I'd have to defend.

one_line: Better than I expected. It's really about why people don't use what you bought, but I never saw a cost or payback figure.
